title: Agents
intro: Nine agents work on your Claude plan. Budgets reset at midnight, Baghdad time.
costTip: Agents run on your Claude plan. This is what the same tokens would cost on the API.
promptTip: Prompt version {{n}}, saved {{date}}. The code is the first 12 characters of its fingerprint.
totals: Today: <f>{{tokens}}</f> tokens and <f>{{turns}}</f> turns across {{agents}}, about <c>{{cost}}</c> at API prices.
totalsNone: No agent has run yet today.

cl.okTitle: Agents run on your Claude plan
cl.okBody: Claude Code <f>{{version}}</f> is signed in on this Mac, and no API key is set.
cl.okBodyNoVersion: Claude Code is signed in on this Mac, and no API key is set.
cl.outTitle: Claude isn’t signed in on this Mac
cl.outBody: Agents can’t run until you sign in. Run this in Terminal, then check again.
cl.unknownTitle: Couldn’t confirm Claude is signed in
cl.unknownBody: The sign-in state is unknown for now. Check again, or run claude login in Terminal if agents fail to run.
cl.keyTitle: An Anthropic API key is set
cl.keyBody: <cmd>{{var}}</cmd> is set, so agent usage could fall back to pay-as-you-go billing. Remove it from <cmd>backend/.env</cmd> and your shell, then restart Atlas.
cl.missTitle: Claude Code isn’t installed on this Mac
cl.missBody: Atlas’s agents run on the Claude Code command-line tool. Install it, sign in with <cmd>claude login</cmd>, then check again.
cl.failBody: Atlas’s server didn’t answer, so the result is unknown. Try again.
cl.readyToastBody: Agents can run on your Claude plan.

chk.loginSkip: Not checked: Claude Code wasn’t found
chk.keyPass: No Anthropic API key is set

err.title: Couldn’t load the agents
err.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>, then try again.

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.body: Atlas adds its nine agents the first time the agents service starts. Restart Atlas with <cmd>./atlas up</cmd>.
